segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Sorry to keep you waiting. Well, firstly, let me give you this booklet. It tells you a bit more about the school, the courses and the social activities we offer. Now, on the first page, there’s an outline of this morning’s activities. There, you see? The programme starts at 10 o’clock. Try not to be late as it’s a very full day. At 10 o’clock, all the new students will gather in the Main Hall to meet the Principal and the rest of the staff. In fact, you spend most of the morning in the Main Hall.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Where’s that?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: I’ll show you in a minute. Just let me quickly run through this morning’s events first and then I’ll explain how to get there.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, OK.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Right. Where were we? Yes, so, the Principal’s talk will last about fifteen minutes and then the Director of Studies will talk to you for half an hour about the courses and the different requirements for each. After that, the Student Adviser will tell you about the various services and activities we offer to students. Any questions?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: SO, all of this is in the Main Hall?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: That’s right. And then you’ll go next door to Classroom 5 at 11 o’clock.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: What happens there?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: You’ll have a test.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Test? I don’t like the sound of that. What sort of test?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Oh, it’s nothing to worry about. It’s just a placement test to help us find your level of English so that we can put you in the right class. It won’t last long.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: But how do I find the Main Hall?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Right; if you look on the back of the booklet I gave you, you’ll see a map of the school. Let me

segments.speaker: SHOW YOU. LOOK
segments.en: you came in through the Main Entrance, here, and now we’re here at Reception. Now, to get to the Main Hall, you walk on to the end of this corridor in front of you and then you turn left. Walk along past the Language Laboratory and then past the Library, which is next to the Language Lab, on the same side, and facing you is the Main Hall, at the end of the corridor. You can’t miss it.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: SO it’s next to the Library, in fact.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes, that’s right.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I should be able to find that. And do you have a Computer Laboratory?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes, we do.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Could you tell me where that is?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Certainly, yes. You go down to the end of this corridor again but, this time, don’t turn left; turn right, away from the Main Hall. The Computer Lab. is immediately on your right. OK?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: And where’s the staff room, in case I need to find a teacher at some stage?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: The staff room is near the main entrance, on the left over there, just opposite the Reception desk. In a day or two, I’m sure you’ll find your way around very easily.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Oh, one last thing. Is there a student common room?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Oh yes, I forgot to mention that. It’s this area here, very close to where we are now, to the right of the Reception desk as you come in the main entrance. There’s tea and coffee facilities there.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Great. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: You’re welcome.
